response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment (ambulantné ošetrenie) for a brain concussion (Gehirnerschütterung) that occurred during a trip. Clause A4.1 covers reasonable and necessary medical expenses, including outpatient treatment, resulting from an acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing (A5.1 would apply if that were the case), and the treatment was necessary and provided in response to an acute injury."}
